definitions.explanation: Having a large diameter or girth.

examples.english: Please make the report title bold.

notes:
{太|ふと}い is an i-adjective describing thickness or large diameter.

FORMS:
- Adverbial: {太|ふと}く
- Noun form: {太|ふと}さ (thickness)
- Verb: ⟦{太|ふと}る→太る：01190_futoru⟧ (to get fat)

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {太|ふと}い⟦{木|き}→木：00524_ki⟧: thick tree
- {太|ふと}い⟦{線|せん}→線：09901_sen⟧: thick/bold line
- ⟦{足|あし}→足：00575_ashi⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{太|ふと}い: to have thick legs
- {太|ふと}い⟦{声|こえ}→声：02207_koe⟧: deep/booming voice
- {太|ふと}⟦{字|じ}→字：01606_ji⟧: bold text

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {太|ふと}い ↔ ⟦{細|ほそ}い→細い：02962_hosoi⟧ (thin, slender)

FOR PEOPLE:
Use ⟦{太|ふと}っている→太る：01190_futoru⟧ (to be fat) rather than {太|ふと}い when describing overweight people. {太|ふと}い⟦{人|ひと}→人：00476_hito⟧ can sound blunt or rude.
